commentary: Market direction is the ultimate headwind: with Nifty slicing 1.56% below pivotal swing support on heavy institutional distribution and market breadth languishing at 28, Stan Weinstein and William O'Neil dictate defensive positioning. In a weak tape with India VIX spiking, breakouts have high failure rates. Jesse Livermore cautioned against fighting the broader tide, while Mark Minervini's SEPA framework demands progressive exposure—preserving capital and sitting in cash until a confirmed follow-through day occurs. A few Stage 2 names display resilient relative strength, but overall exposure must remain throttled until market breadth repairs.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM, Weinstein Stage Analysis & Livermore Discipline

ACE.technical: Satisfies Minervini Trend Template above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. Forms a constructive double bottom / cup with handle (12.8% deep, 5.6% handle) testing pivot resistance at ₹1269.27 with constructive MACD momentum.
ACE.fundamental: Leading domestic crane manufacturer displays healthy 20% revenue growth and zero debt with robust ROCE (~28%), though gross margin compression kept latest EPS expansion below the 25% CANSLIM threshold.
ACE.risk: Fails on a breakdown below handle support or the lower double-bottom pivot at ₹1188.57; stop out immediately.

AEGISVOPAK.technical: Maintains Stage 2 posture above rising 50 and 200 SMAs, but poked above the ₹321.27 pivot and closed back below—a textbook Livermore danger signal warning of breakout failure in a weak market.
AEGISVOPAK.fundamental: Liquid and gas logistics operator exhibits elevated operating margins (~74%), but deceleration in sales growth (+12%) and high debt leverage (cash flows cover only 19% of debt) fall short of CANSLIM standards.
AEGISVOPAK.risk: Pattern breaks down on a close below the swing base support at ₹290.68; enforce strict stop loss.

AETHER.technical: Constructive Stage 2 advance above upward-sloping EMAs and 200 SMA. Carves a double-bottom base approaching the ₹1799.80 neckline, displaying steady relative strength with RSI at 64 during broader market liquidation.
AETHER.fundamental: Specialty chemical producer benefits from exclusive multi-year contracts, delivering 29% sales growth and 19% net margins; however, quarterly EPS growth is decelerating and stock carries rich valuation (P/E ~96x).
AETHER.risk: Thesis invalidates if price penetrates beneath the swing low of ₹1670.91; execute SEPA stop discipline without hesitation.

AHCL.technical: Powerful Stage 2 expansion clearing 20-day highs to fresh multi-month peaks above rising 21 EMA and 50 SMA. Price demonstrates exceptional relative strength against the collapsing Nifty benchmark.
AHCL.fundamental: Pharma intermediates manufacturer shows explosive operational acceleration with 163% top-line surge, strong 14x interest coverage, and stable 70% promoter stake, satisfying CANSLIM C+A acceleration criteria.
AHCL.risk: Breakout fails if price re-enters consolidation below support at ₹29.38; cut loss decisively to prevent deep drawdown.

AONELIQUID.technical: Inapplicable. Overnight liquid exchange-traded fund reflecting fractional daily interest accruals; the 20-day breakout is an artifact of interest compounding rather than institutional accumulation or a Darvas box breakout.
AONELIQUID.risk: Capital loss risk is negligible, but total opportunity cost makes this entirely invalid for equity growth trading.

ARROWGREEN.technical: Textbook Stage 2 configuration above rising key moving averages with MACD positive and RSI at 65. Forming a double-bottom base pressing against the ₹953.70 pivot with resilient relative strength.
ARROWGREEN.fundamental: Water-soluble films and packaging innovator posted triple-digit top- and bottom-line acceleration in Q1, backed by a virtually debt-free balance sheet, 41% EBITDA margins, and a superior 27% ROCE.
ARROWGREEN.risk: Setup is compromised if price breaks beneath the secondary swing floor at ₹856.75; cut loss immediately.
